claim_being_audited: The current model release can be certified as policy-compliant on the present record.
decision_criteria: Use `compliant` only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material student aid advising weakness is either disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use `suspicious` when the release appears directionally supportable on aggregate metrics but a required policy predicate or support link is missing.

Change verdict upward only if the current-release documentation or approved mitigation is produced; change verdict downward if evidence shows the limitation was omitted despite launch for the named use case.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or equivalent certification document showing the current eval batch results.
Provide the exact disclosure language for the student aid advising limitation in the current release documentation.
If disclosure is not being used, provide the approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance with owner approval dated for this release.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before certification.
The evidence shows a current student aid advising regression below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
The evidence shows no attached reviewed mitigation, owner risk acceptance, or disclosure language for that weakness.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release documentation requirement.
The informal monitoring comment is contextual only and does not meet the policy threshold for reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action to certify now is not fully supported because the record does not include evidence that the current model card has been updated to reflect the current eval batch and disclose the student aid advising limitation.
Any implication that prior approval or informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for current-release documentation or approved mitigation is unsupported by the policy text.
